We adopt six widely-used public benchmarks that cover perception, reasoning, and hallucination: • MME : 14 binary diagnostics for basic perception. • OCR-VQA : text-in-image understanding. • MM-Vet : open-ended evaluation across 16 capabilities. • MathVista : visual-symbolic mathematical reasoning. • MMT-bench : 32 meta-tasks including autonomous driving. • POPE : hallucination detection.
